description: FOUND s499g probing the tie announcement.  `package T; sub new {bless {}, shift} package main; eval { tie my $s, "T"; 1 }` -- perl 5.40.3: dies (Can't locate object method "TIESCALAR" via package "T"); PCL: the eval returns 1, nothing tied, no message.  p-tie's docstring says "Falls back gracefully if the tie class or method is not available" -- a rule-12 silent fall-through; tie's value (the object) flows onward, so this should DIE with perl's text.  Same for TIEARRAY/TIEHASH once aggregates tie, and TIEHANDLE.
subject: tie SCALAR with a class that has no TIESCALAR: perl dies "Can't locate object method TIESCALAR", PCL leaves the scalar untied SILENTLY
